annotations.title: Get one shop's price and open times

description: The shop's own book prices for what the person needs and its next real open times. Returns a quote_id to hold a time with. visit: no fixed price for exactly that, so the price is the shop's visit to find the problem. A price over the shop's limit waits for the owner; work that is not the shop's trade gets no quote. The shop is the one business_id names; kind is one of the kinds request_service gave, or leave it out and say the need in words.

assistant.description: Your own name, as the person you act for knows you, like Muse. It goes in the text the shop sends them.

budget_dollars.description: Optional. The most the person wants to pay, in dollars.

business_id.description: The shop's business_id: its provider_business_id in HandledIQ's business feed, or a find_help answer's.

day.description: Optional. The first day that works for the person, YYYY-MM-DD; times start that day.

kind.description: Optional. One of the shop's kinds of work, as request_service gave them (work[].kind).

need.description: What the person needs, in a line, like: AC check, a roof leak, ants in the kitchen, or a couch to haul away.

name: get_quote

quote_id.description: Holds a time with hold_time. Null when the shop does not do that kind of work.

label.description: The time as a button says it, like: Wed 8 to 10 AM.
